pluginDescription: Ships the OpenCode Go provider, a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header and the rolling / weekly / monthly usage
dialog.title: OpenCode Go usage
dialog.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the text manually
usage.error.noProvider: No provider points at the OpenCode Go endpoint
usage.error.noKey: The provider has no API key yet
usage.error.badKey: The API key contains a non-ASCII character; paste it again
usage.error.auth: The API key is invalid or expired
usage.error.entitlement: This key has no OpenCode Go subscription
usage.error.network: The request failed or timed out
usage.error.parse: The response could not be parsed
guide.title: Getting started
guide.tip: The plugin never changes SiYuan's configuration on its own: each step below runs only after you click it.
guide.warn: Use at your own risk: this plugin is not an official OpenCode client and is not on OpenCode's validated-client list. OpenCode states that Go is meant for OpenCode and for coding agents producing similar traffic, that it monitors for abuse, and that validated third-party clients are not guaranteed to keep working. Breaching its terms of service can get your access restricted or terminated, so do not use this to bypass usage limits.
guide.step1.title: 1. Create the OpenCode Go provider
guide.step1.desc: The plugin creates the provider in SiYuan's own AI settings page together with the required headers.
guide.step1.done: The OpenCode Go provider is ready
guide.step1.failed: Creating the provider failed; turn on the debug log and check the console
guide.step2.title: 2. Fill in the credentials
guide.step2.desc: Paste the API key and add models on that provider in SiYuan's own AI settings page.
guide.step3.title: 3. Check
guide.step3.desc: The plugin checks the provider, the headers, the API key, the model count, the session variable and the usage endpoint.
guide.step3.done: Check finished, see the result below
settings.addModelsTip: Fetch the model list from `/v1/models` and add the entries the provider does not have; existing entries are never duplicated, renamed or re-measured.
settings.addModelsNothing: Nothing to add; the endpoint lists {total} model(s)
settings.repairTip: Fills in missing required headers and endpoint fields and strips blanks/zero width characters from the API key; a deleted provider is rebuilt.
settings.repairDone: The provider config has been repaired
settings.headerStrategyTip: How x-opencode-session is filled: when on, every conversation sends its own stable ID, written before the request leaves. When off, the static ID below is used for everything.
settings.staticSessionIdTip: Used when per-conversation sending is off, and by other plugins relaying requests to the same endpoint; leave empty to generate an installation level ID.
settings.userAgentModeTip: The official documentation asks clients to identify themselves instead of using a generic SDK name.
settings.customUserAgentTip: Only used when the previous item is set to custom.
settings.inlineUsage: Show usage in the agent panel
settings.inlineUsageTip: Only shown while the OpenCode Go endpoint is in use; click it for details.
settings.inlineWindows: Windows shown below the agent input
settings.inlineWindowsTip: Only affects the line under the agent input; the dialog always shows the 5 hour, weekly and monthly windows.
settings.usageStyleTip: Whether the percentages in the dialog and under the agent input show the amount used or the amount left; the default is the used amount the endpoint reports.
settings.topBarButtonTip: Registers a plugin button in the top bar that opens the usage dialog; off by default.
settings.usageDialogTip: Open the dialog at any time to view the rolling / weekly / monthly usage, the current session ID and the endpoint error detail.
settings.intervalTip: 30 - 3600 seconds; opening the settings page or the detail dialog refreshes once.
settings.debugLogTip: Print diagnostics to the developer console.
check.modelsEmpty: none yet (use Add all available models below)
check.dismissed: deleted manually, use Create the provider above to rebuild it
check.apiKeyDirty: holds blanks/zero width characters (chat will be rejected; Repair now strips them)
check.apiKeyNonAscii: contains a non-ASCII character (Repair now strips blanks and zero width characters, the rest has to be pasted again)
message.variableTip: The OPENCODE_GO_SESSION variable in your variable store is maintained by this plugin; do not delete or rename it.
